description: This Java source file defines the ShuffleTransportContext class, which extends TransportContext to support a customized shuffle service in Apache Spark. It modifies the Netty channel pipeline to handle IO-intensive messages, such as FINALIZE_SHUFFLE_MERGE, in separate handlers, including a custom decoder and handler for processing finalize shuffle merge requests.

classes.name: ShuffleTransportContext
classes.description: A specialized TransportContext for handling shuffle data with support for separate handlers for IO-intensive messages, including custom decoding and processing of finalize shuffle merge requests.

classes.name: ShuffleMessageDecoder
classes.description: A Netty decoder that wraps MessageDecoder to detect finalize shuffle merge requests and convert them into internal RPC requests.

classes.name: RpcRequestInternal
classes.description: A record representing internal RPC requests for finalize shuffle merge, not directly handled by TransportChannelHandler.

classes.name: FinalizedHandler
classes.description: A Netty handler that processes RpcRequestInternal messages of type FINALIZE_SHUFFLE_MERGE by invoking the transport request handler.

methods.name: initializePipeline
methods.description: Initializes the Netty pipeline with handlers, adding a finalize handler if needed.

methods.name: addHandlerToPipeline
methods.description: Adds the finalize handler to the pipeline when separateFinalizeShuffleMerge is enabled.

methods.name: getDecoder
methods.description: Returns the appropriate message decoder, using a custom decoder if finalizeWorkers is configured.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes ByteBuf messages, detecting finalize shuffle merge requests and converting them into internal RPC requests.

methods.name: channelRead0
methods.description: Processes RpcRequestInternal messages of type FINALIZE_SHUFFLE_MERGE by invoking the transport request handler.
